evidence: The morphology and structure of the as-deposited MoSe2 on the different substrates was characterized by means of scanning electron microscope (SEM) as displayed in Fig. 2. Grazing Incident X-Ray Diffraction (GI-XRD) characterization of as-deposited MoSe2 at 300 /C14 C provided the corresponding GI-XRD patterns on the different substrates shown in the Fig. 3. The as-deposited MoSe2 structure was further characterized by means of Raman spectroscopy, a paramount technique for the assessment of layered materials. X-ray Photoelectron Spectroscopy (XPS) analysis was conducted to assess the surface chemical composition of the as-deposited MoSe2.
